verdict.rationale: Chronicle documents a real API surface: SDKs in five languages that expose the same resources with the same method names, scoped keys for CI and agent processes, idempotent creation of worlds and runs, and telemetry endpoints such as POST /v1/search. This shows core workflows can be driven programmatically, but nothing claims full UI parity. Several browser-centric features (building worlds and tasks, Compare mode, 'Add trace' to create a task) have no documented API equivalent, and no OpenAPI spec was found. missing for 10: explicit UI/API parity statement, documented API coverage for world building/task authoring/comparisons/trace-to-task, published OpenAPI spec, independent corroboration.
